To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Wisden can be deployed in large structures and can reliably and efficiently collect data from sensors.

(1) the Wisden system can be used to collect and analyze structural data, (2) the Wisden implementation is capable of collecting and transmitting data over a wireless sensor network at 10 Hz, (3) Wisden can be used for real-time monitoring and analysis of a structure and (4) Wisden is capable of collecting data over a period of several weeks without recharging.
Wisden is a wireless sensor network for structural monitoring that provides a reliable data transport protocol, a low-overhead data timestamping mechanism, and a wavelet-based compression scheme.

designing and evaluating a wireless sensor network that can be used to acquire and analyze structural response.
developing the technology for a new class of networked embedded systems that can be deployed in large numbers in a distributed fashion to perform a specific task.
the design of wireless sensor network systems for data acquisition applications that require high data rates, high reliability, and low power consumption.
